Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. You will apply your expertise in reviewing, assessing, and testing AI used across the organization through several workstreams. You will implement a framework for red-teaming and conducting independent assessment and testing of internal AI and support M & A diligence efforts. You will participate in internal AI governance processes by reviewing internal or supplier-provided AI and oversee external/independent assessments of internal AI. You will provide leadership to, and will be accountable for, the adoption and consistent use of standardized AI measurement and monitoring frameworks and tools. This role reports to the Director of the Responsible Use of AI Program and working with the UHG Chief AI Officer.

To be successful in this role, you will bring solid analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance innovation and pragmatism to drive the team and solutions forward, possess an educator’s voice to support organizational growth and maturity, and promote a keen passion for learning and continuous improvement based on the latest AI/ML trends and research.
